notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Rosie triggers, targeting any creature except the Servo.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Rosie ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on the targeted creature.
Repeat from step 2.
